label: Seen Agents
hint: An Agent you open or mark as seen from Unread or Just finished keeps its place, marked as seen, until you reload, click Clear seen or choose a filter. With Leave when the chat closes it moves to Seen as soon as you leave its chat. Applies to this browser only.
notice: Agents you read stay where they were, marked as seen, until you reload or click Clear seen.
clear_seen_hint: Takes the Agents you have read out of this section.
